en: Black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing a country house or small inn on a hill with trees and a path leading up to it. At the left border there is an ornamental drawing of bell-shaped flowers in an Art Nouveau style. The upper left contains the artist's name, and to the right of the flowers is German text that identifies the place as the Bergschlößchen in Sommerfeld, with the proprietor named A. Brunsch. Much of the lower half is left blank for writing a message.
